# First Awakening

It was in a drowsy sleep  
where a deep, yet lucid dream  
let me soar and sway, as if swept  
by an unseen current's gleam –  

I could fly to where the brightest clouds roll  
against a blue, blue sky;  
and in that moment let time lose its hold  
in my boundless skyward high –  

and who could ever know  
that in this quiet moment's bliss  
I’m destined to glow.  

So Hum
